description: For every actual structure \(M\), relation clause \(C\), substitution \(\sigma\) and assignment \(v\), \(C\sigma\) is true at \(v\) exactly when \(C\) is true at \(x\mapsto\sigma(x)^M_v\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.clause_subst_realize.{u, v, w, w', z} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {α : Type w} {β : Type w'} {M : Type z} [L.Structure M] (C : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.FOClause L α)
  (σ : α → L.Term β) (v : β → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.ClauseRealize
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseSubst σ C) v ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.ClauseRealize C fun x => FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize v (σ x)
